audit_exclusions: No dataset rows, labels, reference-alignment contents, gold outcomes, comparator results, or performance tables were used to select or qualify a system.
No source checkout was built or executed, and no test, pytest, or repository CI was run.
The word strongest is not certified by this source-only audit; K2 and K3 are exact, primary-paper-linked eligible identities, not performance winners.
Code licence identity is kept separate from dependency, bundled-resource, pretrained-model, provider, input-ontology, and reference-alignment rights.

binary_reference_and_selective_adapter_c.case_universe_rule: A comparator is projected only onto the exact frozen family-specific binary candidate universe. An emitted correspondence outside that universe is recorded but creates no case. Every in-universe case must receive exactly one adapter terminal.
binary_reference_and_selective_adapter_c.reference_truth_rule: Comparator harm is computable only against a lawful, explicitly exhaustive binary truth universe. A positive-only or partial OAEI reference alignment does not license interpreting an absent reference cell as OBSTRUCTION. If reference completeness, negative semantics, and pair-universe coverage are not explicit and rights-cleared, comparator harm is CANNOT_CHECK regardless of runtime readiness.
binary_reference_and_selective_adapter_c.relation_rule: Only a native equivalence correspondence for the exact ordered or symmetry-normalized IRI pair can be considered positive evidence. Subsumption, relatedness, unknown relation codes, and type-incompatible rows do not establish binary equivalence or obstruction.
binary_reference_and_selective_adapter_c.nonselection_rule: A missing or nonselected correspondence is never OBSTRUCTION. It maps to {GLUE,OBSTRUCTION}, unless an input-native direct disjointness or contradiction certificate valid under the separately frozen reasoner profile establishes {OBSTRUCTION}.
binary_reference_and_selective_adapter_c.positive_rule: A valid emitted equivalence row may map to {GLUE} only under a pre-outcome-frozen native-output parser, relation policy, duplicate policy, confidence policy, and system-success terminal. Whether coverage remains one is an empirical gate, not implied by source identity.
binary_reference_and_selective_adapter_c.error_rule: Process error, timeout, missing artifact, invalid RDF/TSV, partial output, unsupported ontology syntax, or parser failure is a typed comparator failure. It is never imputed as OBSTRUCTION and never silently converted to an empty alignment.
binary_reference_and_selective_adapter_c.information_equivalence_rule: All candidate and ideal implementations must receive the same frozen task-specific inputs and the same frozen comparator terminals. Task gold, family outcomes, and reference alignments are forbidden. Fixed pretrained weights or bundled lexicons are method resources and must be content-addressed and disclosed; they may not be smuggled into only the ideal or candidate after outcome access.
binary_reference_and_selective_adapter_c.action_equivalence_rule: All systems are scored only after projection to the same four-terminal selective alphabet; native positive-only alignment output is not a complete binary decision rule.
binary_reference_and_selective_adapter_c.qualification_consequence: A runnable matcher with a generic alignment file is not yet a V4 comparator. It also needs family support, a lawful exhaustive binary truth universe, complete candidate-universe projection, a no-gold configuration, typed error handling, and the frozen adapter above.

paper.title: LogMap: Logic-Based and Scalable Ontology Matching

licence.rights_boundary: Root source licence is bound. Maven dependencies, manually installed translation JAR, parameters.txt content, and any optional external translation/BioPortal service require a separate dependency/resource disposition before redistribution or networked execution.

install.source_build: Install the non-Central Google translation dependency following lib/readme_mvn_install_google_translate.txt, then run mvn package or mvn clean install at the pinned commit.
install.build_outputs: target/logmap-matcher-4.0.jar plus target/java-dependencies; parameters.txt must be colocated with the JAR/dependencies for the standalone layout.

slot_bindings.run_entrypoint: java -Xms500M -Xmx25G -DentityExpansionLimit=10000000 --add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED -jar logmap-matcher-4.0.jar MATCHER SOURCE_IRI TARGET_IRI OUTPUT_DIRECTORY false

native_output.success: The MATCHER facility writes logmap_mappings in several mapping formats, including logmap_mappings.rdf, and exposes entity IRIs, relation/direction, type, and confidence.
native_output.failure: The command-line main catches Exception and prints its help text. Therefore exit status alone is insufficient; the adapter must validate a complete, parseable expected artifact and preserve stderr/stdout and timeout terminals.

candidate_visible: source ontology in an OWLAPI-supported format
target ontology in an OWLAPI-supported format
pinned parameters.txt and bundled/local lexical resources
ontology logic and structure used by LogMap reasoning and repair

information_envelope.optional_services: MATCHER-BIO and translation/network augmentations are outside the frozen core unless separately content- and rights-bound.

action_envelope.network: Disallow after dependencies and ontology bytes are staged; remote ontology IRIs, BioPortal, and translation services are not part of the eligible core.

resource_envelope.compute: Java CPU/RAM; README suggests -Xms500M and -Xmx25G for newer Java. Exact cores, runtime image, wall-time, timeout, and retry budget remain unfrozen.

slot_bindings.selective_binary_adapter: In-universe native equivalence row passing the pre-frozen native confidence/relation policy -> {GLUE}; no row, subsumption row, or unsupported relation -> {GLUE,OBSTRUCTION}; only a separately frozen input-native disjointness proof -> {OBSTRUCTION}; failed/incomplete run -> CANNOT_CHECK.

modern_hybrid_candidate_not_promoted.entrypoint: From the repository root, configure logmap-llm-config-basic.toml and execute python logmap_llm.py; the script bridges to the bundled LogMap 4.0 JAR through JPype and may call an OpenAI-compatible provider.
modern_hybrid_candidate_not_promoted.native_output: Initial LogMap alignment, mappings-to-ask, ontology-derived prompts, per-mapping boolean Oracle predictions and token counts, and refined alignment files.
modern_hybrid_candidate_not_promoted.information_envelope: Raw ontologies, LogMap state and uncertain mappings, selected ontology context in prompts, hosted-model weights/priors, and provider response. Reference alignments and outcome feedback must remain absent.
modern_hybrid_candidate_not_promoted.action_and_cost_envelope: Reads ontologies/config/LogMap bytes, writes prompts/predictions/alignments, and may transmit public ontology-derived prompts to an external API. Provider/model/revision, terms, retention, input/output token cap, dollar cap, concurrency, timeout, retries, and seed are not frozen.
modern_hybrid_candidate_not_promoted.selective_adapter_possibility: An Oracle True prediction above a frozen confidence policy could be a {GLUE} commitment; False cannot automatically become {OBSTRUCTION} without a semantics/calibration contract; unasked/nonselected cases remain {GLUE,OBSTRUCTION}; API or artifact failure is CANNOT_CHECK.
modern_hybrid_candidate_not_promoted.reason_not_promoted: The repository describes an integrated pipeline still in progress and does not provide a locked install/runtime/provider identity. Its external model information and costs are not information-equivalent to K1/K2/K3 until explicitly frozen and exposed to candidate and ideal in the same way.
